name: branding-fintech-brand-application-mockups
title: Navy fintech identity across browser, app store and POS device
whatItIs: A branding presentation board in deep navy and lilac. A smiling woman in a navy jumper holds a card terminal showing the logo; on the right, a browser tab with the URL bar and an app-store listing card display the handwritten-style 'p' monogram in white on navy.
whatItMeans: Trustworthy, friendly and human: navy communicates reliability, while the script monogram and smiling photo soften the finance world.
techniques: Show the logo in the small places where people meet it: favicon, URL, app icon, payment screen.
Match the photo's clothing colour to the brand navy so the person feels part of the identity.
Split the board into flat colour blocks and cards with rounded corners, so each application sits in its own tidy frame.
Use a single monoline script 'p' as an icon that works at tiny sizes.
Layer light card shadows and blurred backdrops for depth without breaking the flat brand palette.
bestFor: Brand rollouts needing to show digital touchpoints

vocabulary.definition: Any place a customer meets a brand, such as an app icon or a terminal.
The tiny icon shown in a browser tab.
A logo built from one or more initials.
Repeating the brand colour in photography and clothing for cohesion.
